name: Snatch and Grab
label: Quest
description: Master Mathias Shaw sends agents to Jerod's Landing for shipping intelligence. The Defias Brotherhood uses the river dock to move supplies in secret.

clips.title: The story
paras: Master Mathias Shaw sends agents to Jerod's Landing for shipping intelligence. The Defias Brotherhood uses the river dock to move supplies in secret.

Master Mathias Shaw tests aspiring operatives who seek a place in Stormwind's covert intelligence wing. He asks for finesse and stealth, not brute force. SI:7 agents take down key figures quietly and recover important papers without drawing the realm into open scandal. Each new operative must prove they can work unseen.

Jerod's Landing lies on the river in southern Elwynn, south of Goldshire and just east of the Maclure Vineyards. The Defias Brotherhood seized the once-quiet dock and made it an illicit route. Smuggled arms, supplies, and contraband cross the water from Redridge toward Westfall, beyond the reach of royal road patrols.

Master Mathias Shaw warns agents that capture, compromise, or death leaves them without the Crown's support. Stormwind and its spymasters will deny knowing they ever existed. Recovering the Defias Dockmaster's schedule gives SI:7 proof of the Brotherhood's supply lines while keeping Stormwind's official involvement hidden.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our operatives in the field are reporting heavy Defias activity south of Goldshire. The reports indicate that the Defias have taken over Jerod's Landing and are now using it as a way to smuggle large quantities of contraband from Redridge to Westfall.
I need you to infiltrate the dock house and get me that shipping schedule, friend. You will probably find it buried deep in the pockets of the Dockmaster.
...and friend, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your mortality wanes with every moment you waste loitering in the barracks, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am astonished... Astonished that Keryn finally found a recruit that could possibly have the makings of a proper adventurer. Take this blade, friend. A day will come when you will be called upon again to serve the SI:7. Hone your skills, keep your eyes open and that blade sharp.
You won't see us coming but you'll feel it when we get there...
